implementation_evidence: The health payload is a module-level constant dictionary.
The health handler no longer imports or reads settings.
The health handler does not import managed_read_session, SessionLocal, engine, ORM models, auth services, permission services, org services, or execution services.
The outermost middleware returns JSONResponse directly and does not call call_next() for health paths.

test_evidence.db_failure_simulation: Tests monkeypatch DB/session and middleware dependencies to raise if called; /health, /api/backend/health, and /api/public/health still return the lightweight payload.
